front_matter.text: Isiyaasa mas'aafay Kiristtoosi yelettanaappe kase, hosppun s'eetu laytsaa heeraan Yerusaalamen de'eedda, timbbitiyaa odiyaa Isiyaasa suntsan s'eesettee. Aa suntsaa biletsaykka, «S'oossay Ashshiyaawaa» giyaawaa. Ha mas'aafaa heezzu huup'e huup'e kifiletuwaan shaakkiide be'anaw danddayeettee.

1. Shemppuwaa 1ppe biide 39 gakkanaw de'iyaawe gedissa baggana de'iyaa Yihudaa kawutetsaa Asoore giyaa wolk'k'aama shooro kawutetsay wolk'k'aantsiyaawaa odee. Yihudaa hewaa mala hadan yeggeeddawe Asoore kawutetsaa minotetsaa gidennaan, asaa nagaraa, S'oossaw azazettenan is's'iyaawaa, hewaadankka unttunttu S'oossan ammanettennan aggiyaawaa gidiyaawaa Isiyaasi malaateedda. Timbbitiyaa odiyaawe k'onc'c'e haasayaaninne oosuwaan asaanne asaa kaaletsiyaawantta s'illotetsaynne suure pirdday kumeedda de'uwaakko simmana mala akeekisseeda; k'ay S'oossaw azazettenan aggiyaawe gammaa meettettussaanne bashshaa kaaletsiyaawaa unttunttoo minisiide odeedda. Isiyaasi hewaa bollakka gujjiide odiidde, yaana wodetuwaan sa'aa yuushshuwaan saruu kumeedda, pokkobay bayinnan kaaletsiyaa, Daawita zare gidiyaa kaatii yaanaw de'iyaawaa kasetiide odeedda.

2. Shemppuwaa 40ppe biide 55 gakkanaw de'iyaa kifiliyaappe dariyaa baggay Yihudaa Asay omoodettiide Baabloone beedda wode, unttunttu de'uu kunddeeddanne unttunttu hidootaa k'ans's'eedda wodetuwaabaa odee. Timbbitiyaa odiyaawe S'oossay bare asaa he hanotaappe billi yeddana wodiinne unttunttu ooratsa de'uwaa doommana mala, unttuntta Yerusaalame afana wodii matatteeddawaa odeedda. Ha shemppatuwaa giddon k'onc'c'iide beettiyaa yewuu S'oossay taarikiyaw Goda gidiyaawaanne bare asaw aw de'iyaa halchchuwaa, hewenne Israa'eeliyaa asaa baggana anjjettanaw de'iyaa asaakko unttunttu biide, ootsanaw bessiyaawaa odiyaa kifiliyaa.

3. Shemppuwaa 56ppe biide 66 gakkanaw de'iyaa kifilii odiyaawe guyyen Yerusaalamen de'iyaa asaawaa; he Asay S'oossay bare asaw geleedda k'aalaa polanawaa geeshshiide eranaw, markka gidiyaabaa demmanaw koyiidde utteedda. Unttunttu loytsi ootsanaadan koyetteedda oosotuu s'illotetsaa, suure pirddaa, Sambbataa bonchchiyaawaa, yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaawaanne woosan sheekkiyaawaa. Ha kifiliyaan eretteedda shemppuu 61:1-2 de'iyaawaa gidishin, Yesuusi koyiro oosuwaa doommiidde, bare s'eessaabaw markka ootsiide shiishsheedda k'aalatuu ha paydotuwaa giddon de'iino.
S'oossay Eedooma Muriyaawaa Iyeruusaaleemo Anjjiyaawaa Gidussaa 32:1—35:10
Asaa Zarii ubbay S'oossaa Bagga Gidanaw Danddayussaa 56:1-8

verses.text: Ooziyaane, Iyo'aataami, Akaazinne Hizk'k'iyaasi Yihudaa kaatetuwaa gideedda wode, Amoos'a na'ay Isiyaasi Yihudaabaanne Yerusaalamebaa be'eedda sas'ay hawaa.
Salotuwaan de'iyaawanttoo, sisite; sa'aan de'iyaawanttoo, sisite; ayaw gooppe, Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaageedda; «Taani naanatuwaa dichcha gatsaad; shin unttunttu taw makkaleeddino.
Booray bare godaa eree; hariikka barena mooddeeddawaa zadaluwaa eree; shin Israa'eelatuu erikkino; ta asatuu akeekikkino.

«Nagaraa ootsiyaa kawutetsaw, hintte naak'uwaan dees'etteedda asaw, iitaa ootsiyaa zariyaw, hintte mayzatuwaa tunatetsaa kaaliyaa naatoo, hinttenttoo aayye ana! Med'inaa Godaa hintte aggeeddita; Israa'eeliyaa Geeshsha sheneyeeddita; aw zokkiyaa zaareeddita.
Hintte ayaw makkalaa bolla makkalaa gujji gujji biitee? Ayaw k'aykka murettanaw koyiitee? Hintte kumentsaa huup'ii saketteedda; hintte kumentsaa wozanaykka daabureedda.

Gediyaa birad'd'iyaappe huup'iyaa binnaanaa gakkanaw pas'atetsay baawa; madutsay, gaafunne giiyiyaabay de'ee; unttunttunne giiyibeykkino, woy meec'etti k'ashettibeykkino, woy zayitiyaan okettiide shuggibeykkino.
«Hintte gaddii dirk'k'aletiide bayana; hintte katamatuukka taman s'uugetteeddino; hintte goshshaa hintte s'eellishin, allagatuu akkiino; imatsaa asatuu, mela ashana.
Yerusaalame katamay woyniyaa turaa naagiyaa daasiyaadan, leekiyaa naagiyaa golliyaadan morkkiyaan diretteedda katamaadan haniide atteeda.
Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday nuw amareeda zaratuwaa ashshenentto, nuuni Sodooma katamaadaaninne Gamoora katamaadan haneeddoshin» yaageedda.
Hinttenoo, Sodooma mooddiyaawantto ubbatoo, Med'inaa Godaa k'aalaa sisite! Hinttenoo, Gamoora asaa ubbatoo, nu S'oossaa higgiyaa sisite!

Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Hintte yarshshuwaa daruu taw ayaa go"ii? Hanno gakkanaw hintte taw shiishsheedda s'uugetteedda orgge dorssatuwaanne d'iikkeedda mehiyaa mod'd'uwaa yarshshuwaa taani kallaad; korumaa booratuwaa, dorssaa maratuunne deeshshatuwaa suutsan taani nashettikke.
Hintte taw goyinnanaw yiyaa wode, ta Geeshsha Golliyaa dabaabaa hinttena yed'd'ite geeddawe oonee?

Simmi hada yarshshuwaa ahiyaawaa aggite! Hintte c'uwissiyaa is'aanay taana sheneyee; aginaa s'eeruwaa hintte bonchchiyaa gallassaa, hintte Sambbataanne hintte keereedda yaa'atuwaa, ha shiik'atuwaa ubbaa iitatetsaana ittippe walaketteeddawantta taani danddaykke.
Aginaa s'eeruwaa hintte bonchchiyaa gallassaanne keeretteedda hintte baalaa gallassatuwaa taani is's'aad; unttunttu taw tookuwaa gideeddino; taani unttuntta tookkaadde daaburaad.
«Hintte kushiyaa mic'c'iide, hintte woossiyaa wode, taani ta ayfiyaa hintteppe gentsana; hintte daro woosaa woossinttokka, taani sisikke; ayaw gooppe, hintte kushii suutsan munak'etteedda.
Meec'ettite; geeyite; hintte iita oosuwaa ta sintsaappe diggite. Iitaa ootsiyaawaa aggite;
lo"obaa ootsanaw tamaarite. S'illo pirddaa koyite; un"etteeddawanttu morggiyaa oyk'k'ite. Aawuu bayinnawanttoo pirddite; asinay hayk'k'eedda mac'c'a asatoo mootettite» yaagee.
K'aykka Med'inaa Goday, «Haayite; ane zorettoytte. Hintte nagaray baaraadan zo"inttokka, shachchaadan boos's'ana; suutsaadan zo"inttokka, puuttuwaadan boos's'ana.
Hintte eeno giide, taw azazettooppe, gadiyaappe mokkiyaa murutaa maana.
Shin hintte is's'aaddi giide makkalooppe, mashshaan meetettana» yaagee. Med'inaa Goday bare doonaappe hawaa haasayeedda.
Ammanetteeda wolk'k'aama katamata waanaade sharmus'a gidaadee! Iza kase suure pirdday kumeeddaano; s'illotetsay kase I giddon de'eedda; shin ha"i asaa wod'iyaawanttu izi giddon de'iino.
Ne biray shi'i kichcheedda; ne lo"o woyniyaa eessaykka haatsaana yeeletteedda.

Hintte daannatuu makkalanchchatuwaanne kayisotuwaa lagetuwaa gideeddino; unttunttu ubbatuukka mattaayiyaa dosiinonne miishshaa yederssiino; aawuu bayinnawanttoo pirddikkino; asinay hayk'k'eedda mac'c'a asatuwaa mootuu unttunttukko shiik'enna.
Hewaa diraw, Goday, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday, Israa'eeliyaa Wolk'k'aamay, hawaadan yaagee; «Ha"i taani taana is'iyaawanttuppe shemppana; taani ta morkkatuwaa bolla ta haluwaa kessana.
Taani ta kushiyaa ne bolla wotsana; ne shi'owaa k'uls's'us's'issaade geeshshana; neenana walaketteeddabaa ubbaa geeshshaade yedissana.
Taani beniwanttu mala daannatuwaa, koyirowanttu mala zoriyaawantta new zaarana. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, neeni S'illotetsaa Katamaa, Ammanetteeda Katamaa geetettana» yaagee.
S'iyoonee suure pirddan, barenttu nagaraa paas'iyaawanttukka s'illotetsan wozettana.
Shin makkalanchchatuunne nagaranchchatuu laa"uukka me"ana; Med'inaa Godaa aggiyaawanttu d'ayana.
Wotsanaw doseedda wolaa diraw, hintte yeellatana; hintte dooreedda kaashshaa gishshawukka hintte kawushshana.
Bonc'c'ii k'ok'k'ofettiyaa wolaadan, woy dubbi bayinna shoyk'aadan, hintte hanana.
Minuu dalaa gidanawaa; Aa oosuukka s'iifa gidanawaa; unttunttu ittippe s'uugettanawantta; he tamaa toyissiyaawe d'ayana.
Yihudaa biittaabaanne Yerusaalame katamaabaa Amoos'a na'ay Isiyaasi be'eeddawe hawaa.

Wurssetsa gallassatuwaan Med'inaa Godaa Geeshsha Gollii kees'etteedda derii deretuwaa ubbaappe d'ok'k'iide beettana; zoozetuwaa ubbatuwaappekka bollaanna d'ok'k'u d'ok'k'u gaana. Kawutetsatuwaan de'iyaa Asay ubbay aakko zattana.

Daro Asay yiide, «Haayite! Med'inaa Godaa deriyaa, Yaak'ooba Med'inaa Godaa Geeshsha Golliyaa ane pude kesoytte. I koyiyaawaadan nuuni baana mala, I nuuna bare ogiyaa tamaarissana» yaagana. Ayaw gooppe, higgii S'iyooneppe, S'oossaa k'aalaykka Yerusaalameppe kesana.

Kawutetsatuwaappenne kawutetsatuwaappe gidduwaan I pirddananne daro asatuwaa palumiyaa shaakkana. Unttunttu barenttu mashshaa maraashaa, barenttu tooraakka baac'aa kessanaw k'os's'ana. Kawutetsay kawutetsaa bolla mashshaa dentsenna. Hewaappe guyyiyaan unttunttu mulekka olaa timirttiyaa tamaarikkino.
Hinttenoo, Yaak'ooba zaretoo, haayite! Ane Med'inaa Godaa poo'uwaan hamettoytte.
S'oossaw, ne asaa, Yaak'ooba zaratuwaa aggaada. Unttunttu away doliyaa bagga gadiyaa asatuwaa biittaan kumeeddino; Piliss's'eema asatuwaadan kaayiino. Unttunttu allaga asatuwaana ittippe zuppetiino.
Unttunttu gaddii biraynne work'k'ay kumeeddawaa; unttunttu shaloo zaway baawa. Unttunttu gaddii paray kumeeddawaa; unttunttu paraa gaaretoo zaway baawa.
Unttunttu gaddii eek'atuwaan kumeeddawaa; unttunttu barenttu kushii ootseedda oosoo hokkiide goyinniino.
Hewaa diraw, Asay ubbay tooshettananne kawushshana. Unttunttoo atto gooppa.
Med'inaa Godaa dagamaappenne Aa anggaa bonchchuwaappe attanaw zaallaakko biite; biittaa giddon k'osettite!
Asaa otoruu giiyana; Aa kilahuukka siilana; he gallassi Med'inaa Godaa s'alalay d'ok'k'u d'ok'k'u gaana.
Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday itti gallassaa keereedda. He gallassi otorettiyaawantta, ayyiyaawanttanne d'ok'k'u d'ok'k'u geeddawaantta kawushshana;
adussanne d'ok'k'a gidiyaa Liibaanoosa zigatuwaanne Baasaane wolaa ubbaa d'ayissana;
d'ok'k'a deretuwaakka zoozatuwaakka dembbayana;
katamaa naagiyaa adussa miis'atuwaa ubbaanne katamaa yuushshuwaan de'iyaa mino gimbbetuwaa zik'k'issana;
S'oossay gitanne lo"iyaa markkabatuwaakka haatsaan mitissana.
Asaa otoruu zik'k'i gaana; Aa ayyuukka d'ayana. He gallassi Med'inaa Godaa s'alalay d'ok'k'u d'ok'k'u gaana;
eek'aa ubbaykka ubbaanna d'ayana.
Med'inaa Goday ha gadiyaa k'aatsanaw denddiyaa wode, Aa dagamaappenne Aa anggaa bonchchuwaappe attanaw Asay shuchchaa gonggoloonne biittaa ollaw bak'atana.
He gallassi Asay goyinnanaw med'd'eedda barenttu biraa misiletuwaanne barenttu work'k'aa misiletuwaa oc'c'otoonne hara kafotoo olana.
Med'inaa Goday ha gadiyaa k'aatsanaw denddiyaa wode, Aa dagamaappenne Aa anggaa bonchchuwaappe attanaw unttunttu gonggolo giddonne shuchchaa kooppo giddo bak'atana.
Simmi hayk'k'iyaa asan ammanettiyaawaa aggite! Asay ay maaddanee?
Be'ite, Goday, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday minjjaanne maaduwaa laa"uwaakka Yerusaalameppenne Yihudaappe diggana hanee. Katsaa minjjaanne haatsaa minjjaa ubbaa;
minotuwaanne olanchchatuwaa, daannatuwaanne timbbitiyaa odiyaawantta, kaayiyaawanttanne c'imatuwaa,
olaa gadaawatuwaanne gadiyaa ayissiyaawantta, zoriyaawantta, hiillatiyaawanttanne c'inc'c'a bitanchchatuwaa ubbaa diggana hanee.
Taani yalaga attuma naanatuwaa unttunttu kaappuwaa kessana; guutsaa naanay unttuntta mooddana.
Asay asaa bolla, shooruu shooruwaa bolla denddiide, ittuu ittuwaa sugana. Yalagay c'imaa bolla, kad'etteeddawe bonchchetteeddawaa bolla denddana.
Itti Asay bare aawuwaa golliyaan bare ishatuwaappe ittuwaa oyk'k'iide, «New mayuu de'ee; neeni nuw suntsaa gida; ha koletteedda sa'aa aawotetsaa akka» yaagana.
I he gallassi bare k'aalaa d'ok'k'issiide, «Taanan d'alii baawa; ta son k'umi woy mayuu baawa; hintte bolla taana suntsoppite» yaagana.
Yerusaalame ganddigaaree; Yihuday kunddee; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barenttu oduwaaninne barenttu oosuwaan Med'inaa Godaa bolla denddiide, Aa bonchchuwaa toochchiino.

Unttunttu som"uwaa malay unttunttu bolla markkattee; unttunttu barenttu nagaraa Sodooma asaadan awaayiino; barenttu nagaraa k'ossikkino. Unttunttoo aayye ana! Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barenttu bolla iitabaa aheeddino.
S'illotoo, «Hinttew lo"a gidanawaa» gaade oda; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barenttu oosuwaa ayfiyaa maana.
Iitatoo aayye ana! Unttunttoo iitana; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barenttu kushiyaa oosuwaa gatiyaa akkana.
Yalagatuu ta asaa un"etsiino; mac'c'a asatuukka unttuntta mooddiino. Ta asaw, hinttena kaaletsiyaawanttu hinttena wora kaaletsiino; hintte biyaa ogiyaakka baletsiino.
Med'inaa Goday daannaadan, chilootan uttee; asaa pirddanaw denddee.

Asaa c'imatuwaanne kaaletsiyaawantta pirddanaw shiishiide, Med'inaa Goday, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Ta woyniyaa turaa tokkeeddasaa bayzzeeddawanttu hinttena; hiyyeesatuwaappe bonk'k'eeddabay hintte golliyaan de'ee.
Ta asaa ayaw kinchcheretsiitee? Hiyyeesatuwaa som"uwaa ayaw gaac'c'iitee?» yaagee Goday, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday.

Med'inaa Goday K'aykka, «S'iyoone mac'c'a asatuu otoretteeddino; barenttu ziizziyaa essi akkiide, barenttu ayifiyaan sim"ettiidde, barenttu hametsaa makisiidde, barenttu gediyaa albbuwaa giirissiidde hamettiino.
Hewaa diraw, taani Goday S'iyoone mac'c'a asatuwaa huup'iyaa c'ittuwaan goo'issana. Taani Med'inaa Goday unttunttu huup'iyaa bo"ayana» yaagee.
He gallassi Goday S'iyoone mac'c'a asatuwaa alleek'k'otuwaa, hewanttunne unttunttu gediyaa albbuwaa, shaashiyaa, k'ood'iyaa aleek'k'uwaa,
haytsaa gutichchaa, kushiyaa sagaayuwaa, som"uwaa kammiyaa kutaa,
huup'iyaan wotsiyaa alleek'k'uwaa, k'esiyaan k'achchiyaa sanssalataa, s'eessan danc'c'iyaa danc'c'uwaa, shittuwaa s'aaramusiyaa, kitaafaa,
siid'iyaa migiduwaa, birad'd'iyaanne
minjja mayuwaa, adussa mayuwaa, jaanuwaa, borssaa,
heregaa, liinuwaa giyaa k'ac'inaappe dadetteedda, giddona mayiyaa mayuwaa, binnaanan wotsiyaa alleek'k'uwaanne sharbbiyaa ubbaa bonk'k'a akkana.
Shittuwaa diraw s'ink'k'uwaa gidanawaa; danc'c'uwaa diraw wodoruwaa, goofariyaa diraw bo"aa, adussa mayuwaa diraw waaruwaa, puulaa diraw bak'k'iyaa s'alalaa gidanawaa.
Ne asatuu mashshaan, ne olanchchatuu olan hayk'k'ana.
S'iyoone penggetuwaan de'iyaa Asay yeekkananne zilaalana; mela atteedda, gadiyaan uttana.
He gallassi laappun mac'c'a asatuu itti attumawaa oyk'k'iide, «Nuuni nu k'umaa maana; nu mayuwaa mayyana; ne suntsan s'eesetana mala ootsaadde nu kawushshaa nuuppe k'aaraarikkii» yaagiide woosana.
He gallassi Med'inaa Godaa mitsaa tashii lo"ananne bonchchettana; Israa'eeliyaa asaappe atteedawanttoo he gadiyaa katsay c'eek'k'onne bonchchuwaa gidanawaa.
S'iyoonen attiyaawanttu, Yerusaalamen gam"iyaawanttu, Yerusaalamen pas'a de'iyaawanttunna s'aafettiyaawanttu, «Unttunttu geeshshatuwaa» geetettana.
Goday S'iyoone mac'c'a asatuwaa k'itaa meec'c'ana; pirddaa Ayaanaaninne s'uuggiyaa Ayaanan suutsaa gussiyaa bayzzuwaa Yerusaalameppe I geeshshana.
Med'inaa Goday S'iyoone Deriyaa ubbaa bollanne yan shiik'iyaawanttu bolla gallassi shaariyaanne c'uwaa, k'amma ees's'iyaa tamaa poo'uwaa med'd'ana; bonchchuu ubbaa bolla kammiyaawaa gidanawaa.
I gallassaa aawaa suuluwaappe ashshiyaa kuwaanne gotiyaappenne iraappe bak'ati attiyaasaa gidanawaa.
Taani ta siik'iyaawoo Aa woyniyaa turaa tokkiyaa sa'aawaa siik'uwaa yetsaa yes's'ana.
